column2: For the purposes of this Act “aeronautical services”
the  development,  operation  and  maintenance  of

Aerodromes  classified  as  an 
International
Aerodrome, under subsection (1) of section 13;
the  development,  operation  and  maintenance    of
Aerodromes  other  than  those  referred  to  in
paragraph  (a)  and  the  provision  of  Aerodrome
facilities at such Aerodromes;
the  provision  and  maintenance  of  search,  rescue
and fire fighting services at Aerodromes;
the  provision  and  maintenance  of  an  Aviation
Security Service;
the provision of Air Traffic Services ;
the provision of Aeronautical Information Services;
the  provision  of  Aeronautical  Communication
Services;

the 
provision 
of 
aeronautical 
aids 
for
communication,  navigation  or  surveillance;
the provision of services relating to the supply of
aviation fuel and lubricant to aircraft;
the  provision  of  assistance  or  equipment  for
dispatch of aircraft on the apron, including aircraft
cleaning  services;
the  provision  of  ground  handling  facilities  or
services to aircraft;
the provision of catering services to aircraft; and
the supply of any other service to an aircraft, other
than the services specified above.
